title: Passage 16
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Asking for advice is not so easy.
sentences.cn: 寻求建议并不是那么容易。

sentences.en: In a recent study, 74% of people said they were afraid to ask for advice.
sentences.cn: 在最近的一项研究中，74%的人表示他们害怕寻求建议。

sentences.en: The same also applies to case studies.
sentences.cn: 案例研究中也是如此。

sentences.en: But people who ask for advice are more likely to succeed at a task.
sentences.cn: 但那些寻求建议的人在任务中更有可能成功。

sentences.en: So how do you ask for advice?
sentences.cn: 那么，你该如何寻求建议呢？

sentences.en: Look for the best person to give you advice.
sentences.cn: 寻找最合适的人来给你建议。

sentences.en: It's just like choosing the right belt for an outfit.
sentences.cn: 这就像为一套衣服挑选合适的腰带一样。

sentences.en: It might be easy to ask all your dear friends on social media for advice at once.
sentences.cn: 也许在社交媒体上同时向所有好友寻求建议很容易。

sentences.en: But will you value all the advice equally?
sentences.cn: 但你会同等重视所有的建议吗？

sentences.en: Probably not.
sentences.cn: 很可能不会。

sentences.en: It might be better to choose one or two people whose opinions you value most.
sentences.cn: 最好选择一两个你最看重其意见的人。

sentences.en: Ideally, you can have a dialogue with people who have experience in the topic you're asking about.
sentences.cn: 理想情况下，你可以与在你所询问的话题方面有经验的人进行对话。

sentences.en: For example, in playing chess, provide enough information clearly.
sentences.cn: 例如，在下棋时，要清楚地提供足够的信息。

sentences.en: For example, imagine you can't decide how to organise a club activity.
sentences.cn: 例如，假设你不知道如何组织一次俱乐部活动。

sentences.en: You should provide the topic, the place and the time.
sentences.cn: 你应该提供活动的主题、地点和时间。

sentences.en: You should also consider when to ask.
sentences.cn: 你还应考虑何时询问。

sentences.en: If your questions require a lot of thought, ask the person when he or she is clear-headed.
sentences.cn: 如果你的问题需要深思熟虑，那就要在对方头脑清醒时询问。

sentences.en: Remember to double your efforts in checking the information and not to hurry your decisions.
sentences.cn: 记住，要加倍努力核实信息，不要匆忙做决定。

sentences.en: Be specific when you ask questions.
sentences.cn: 提问时要具体。

sentences.en: Imagine you want to start a business and you find a business owner.
sentences.cn: 假如你想创业，并找到了一位企业主。

sentences.en: Instead of asking, 'What advice do you have for me?'
sentences.cn: 与其问“您能给我什么建议呢？”

sentences.en: Try asking, 'What college classes did you find helpful for starting a business?'
sentences.cn: 不如试着问“您认为哪些大学课程对创业有帮助呢？”

sentences.en: Anyway, don't let the fear of being judged stop you from seeking advice.
sentences.cn: 无论如何，不要因为害怕被评判而不去寻求建议。
